summary: Best 98.283 (r5b3_t01 at 15,949M, CP7; incumbent 94.668), warm, no new trainer code. Bare resumes of the incumbent took the greedy line through the 95% slit, the hole in kill *10, CP7, the first thin wall's gap and under the second wall into the lower lane (94.67 -> 98.05 in ~240M steps). Two changes paid: evals every 25M on this CPU-bound box (69k vs 42k steps/s) and --unstuck-max 0.1 (at the 0.5 cap the late line broke, medians 27-86%; at 0.1 every eval reached the lane, medians to 98%). Null so far: --front-temp 1 --front-band 0.004 at the lane. The last gate (measured): a rare ~300 u launch through a 190 u gap into the closed chimney above the finish - 0/2,048 random macros and 0/32 policy rollouts from the lane finish; training's ceiling flat at 98.3% for ~1.4B steps. Next: velocity-aware novelty (rows in the visited lane with novel upward velocities) or a faster underpass arrival.
